args.text:
Batch: 8 runs (r01–r08), 8 accepted.
Flagged: none.
Cleared: all 8 runs.
- Rigid-body invariance, closure and plane sections passed on all 8 runs.
- No run used the width-free ratio.
- The batch MAD is 0 on every summary, so the large |z| values come from very small differences:
  - centre REGR peak: within 0.1 %/h of 52.84 %/h
  - peak position: 421 µm on every run
  - growth-zone length: 674–705 µm, against a median of 695 µm
  - flank difference: within 0.7 %/h of -12.38 %/h, at 410 µm on every run
- r06 kept one remedy: frames registered on the non-growing tissue before tracking. That is the normal path, and its checks pass.
Common to flagged runs: none were flagged. The velocity, strain-rate and curvature profiles are the same across the batch.
